messages.text: Core valid-command outputs now match across focused and randomized cases. I’m doing a final pass over error paths, stdin/output files, delimiters, and entrypoint cleanliness.

commands.commandLine:
powershell.exe -Command "@'
import subprocess,pathlib,sys,tempfile,os
ref=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip(); ours=[sys.executable,'xsv_port.py']; p=pathlib.Path('probe'); f=str(p/'select.csv')
cases=[
 ['select','dne',f],['select','0',f],['select','6',f],['select','1[0]',f],['select','h1[2]',f],['select','h1[2.0]',f],['select','\"h1',f],['select','\"h1\"[1',f],['select','a-b-',f],
 ['slice','-s','3','-e','2',f],['slice','-i','1','-s','2',f],['slice','-e','2','-l','1',f],
 ['count','-d','::',f],['select','--no-headers','h1',f],
]
for args in cases:
 a=subprocess.run([ref,*args],capture_output=True); b=subprocess.run([*ours,*args],capture_output=True)
 ok=(a.returncode,a.stdout,a.stderr)==(b.returncode,b.stdout,b.stderr)
 print(('OK' if ok else 'DIFF'),args)
 if not ok: print(' REF',a.returncode,repr(a.stdout),repr(a.stderr)); print(' OUR',b.returncode,repr(b.stdout),repr(b.stderr))
# stdin and output
raw=b'h1;h2\\na;2\\nb;1\\n'
for args in [['count','-d',';'],['select','-d',';','2'],['sort','-d',';','-N','-s','2'],['frequency','-d',';','-l','1']]:
 a=subprocess.run([ref,*args],input=raw,capture_output=True); b=subprocess.run([*ours,*args],input=raw,capture_output=True); print('STDIN',args,(a.returncode,a.stdout,a.stderr)==(b.returncode,b.stdout,b.stderr),repr(a.stdout),repr(b.stdout))
'@ | python -"
